summary: Extract five repeated subschemas into their own titled documents and $ref them. Acceptance-preserving: resolve every $ref this adds and the published document comes back, which codegen.patch.differing checks over all 1,054 portable documents.

extractions.defect: the bundle states the pattern '^[A-Z]{3}$' at 86 sites in 62 documents and titles it at none of them, so a consumer reading the schemas cannot tell a currency code from any other three uppercase letters -- two of those sites are an IATA airport code

apart.because: an IATA airport code, not a currency: the same three uppercase letters spelling a different thing

extractions.defect: the bundle states the pattern '^[A-Z]{2}$' at 71 sites in 51 documents and titles it at none of them, so every one of them is a fresh anonymous constraint to a reader and to a generator

the bundle states 'format: uri' beside the pattern '^https://' at 47 sites in 31 documents and titles it at none of them; adcontextprotocol/adcp#8398 is the seven further uri patterns the same omission produced

the bundle states the pattern '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{16,255}$' at 69 sites in 66 documents and titles it at none of them, so a key whose at-most-once semantics a client must honour is indistinguishable from the ten receipt and status identities that share its characters
